_doc: Locked stack for sylvain-builder. Verified against official sources. ADR required for any major bump. See web-references.instructions.md for canonical URLs.
notes: Spring Boot 4.x manages Hibernate, Tomcat and Jackson. Import the Testcontainers BOM explicitly when Testcontainers modules are used.
Baseline verified 2026-10-11 against vendor releases and package registries. The matrix records latest stable releases only; milestones are informational.
Spring AI 2.0.1 is GA. Review its upgrade notes before changing Spring AI APIs; explicit conversation scoping and typed tool inputs remain mandatory.
React 19.3.0 includes the current patched RSC line.
eslint-plugin-react-hooks 7.x supports ESLint 10 and adds new compiler-aware rules.
Vite 8 requires Node 20.19+ or 22.12+; Node 26 LTS is the project baseline.
TypeScript 7 is the native compiler line; keep strict ESM settings.
OWASP LLM Top 10 2025 governs Spring AI tool/function calling and RAG.
